usedFor: Cobot holds coworking bookings and HubSpot holds the contacts that “Create or Update Contact” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “External Booking Created” in Cobot, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Returning visitors are matched by email, so a repeat booking updates one contact instead of making another.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so “Booking Created” needs to pass one or the contact is not made.
